interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks, preferably with 'continental' striping, to designate safe crossing points between the residential area and the park.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Cushions
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential and recreational zone.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the park entrance or potential crossing points to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to improve pedestrian visibility and reduce the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement speed humps to physically slow traffic on this residential stretch.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Adding a furniture zone with trees would provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and the roadway while narrowing the perceived street width to slow traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a safe and predictable access point to the park.

interventions.title: Roadway Striping
interventions.description: Add lane markings to define travel lanes and encourage more predictable driver behavior and speed management.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming (Speed Humps)
interventions.description: Install speed humps or cushions to ensure low vehicle speeds on this residential street.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Formalize a furniture zone for trees and poles to ensure a consistent clear walking width on the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implement speed cushions or humps to slow vehicle speeds on this long, straight residential block.

interventions.title: Parking Enforcement
interventions.description: Enforce regulations against parking vehicles or trailers on sidewalks to maintain a clear path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Physical Barriers
interventions.description: Install bollards or a raised buffer between the roadway and the sidewalk to prevent vehicles from parking on the walkway.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant trees in a furniture zone to provide a physical buffer and improve the street's aesthetic and safety profile.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lighting specifically oriented toward the sidewalk to improve visibility and security along the park perimeter.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Add street trees or a planting strip to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Repair or replace cracked sections of the sidewalk to ensure a smooth, accessible surface for all users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and perceived safety for pedestrians during evening hours.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint to designate a safe crossing area for residents.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair minor cracks and remove vegetation growing through the sidewalk joints to ensure a smooth, trip-free surface.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening / Curb Extension
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk or install a curb extension around the tree to maintain a minimum 4-foot clear walking path for ADA compliance.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Implement a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated and safer crossing point.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Incorporate street trees or a furniture zone to provide a buffer between the walkway and the roadway.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate utility poles to the edge of the sidewalk or underground to clear the pedestrian path.
